fragments.canonicalisation: root fixed at position 0; lexicographic-min over all permutations of the non-root nodes of atom types + 10-slot pair types
fragments.multiplicity: distinct actual node sets with equal content are counted; same (root, family, node set) once

model.first_layer: SiLU(W_x raw108 + b + W_s s), then original 128->96 head

recipe.schedule: linear warmup then one shared relative per-step cosine to min_lr

selection: strict-< best valid MAE, earlier epoch wins a tie; epoch 0 is a candidate

analysis_groups.covered_ordinary: all radius-2 atom signatures seen in train and y > -3
analysis_groups.unseen_ordinary: at least one unseen radius-2 signature and y > -3
analysis_groups.unseen_tail: at least one unseen signature and y <= -3

test_policy: one descriptive read after the best-valid freeze; cannot change checkpoint/epoch/recipe
